contentText: Venezuela’s Supreme Court on Saturday appointed Vice President Delcy Rodriguez as interim president after the United States seized Nicolas Maduro, currently held in a New York detention centre. US President Donald Trump said Washington would run the country until there can be a “safe” transition, sparking fears of a power vacuum. Venezuelan-American journalist and writer, Germania Rodriguez Poleo, shares her insights.
